title: Big-time oil price cut seen next week

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The drop in crude oil prices in the international market is projected to result in a big slash in domestic fuel prices next week. Citing price developments and foreign exchange movements as of Thursday, Leo Bellas, Jetti Petroleum President, said diesel prices are forecast to decline between P4.30 and P4.50 per liter, and gasoline prices will likely go down between P12.50 and P13.50 per liter. Bellas, in a message to journalists Friday, said these figures exclude adjustments to ocean freight and insurance relative to last week.
